rows.text: 机油压力过低时，机油压力警告灯会亮起：机油可能无法充分到达需要润滑的部件。
evidence: Volvo S60L 2016 owner’s manual, Information displays – warning symbols, Low oil pressure: https://www.volvocars.com/en-ca/support/car/s60l/article/5796f223aaefe254c0a801e800894856/ — identifies the low oil pressure warning and instructs the driver to stop the vehicle and engine if it lights while driving.

MAHLE, Engine Bearing Failures, p. 20, section 17: https://www.mahle-aftermarket.com/media/local-media-north-america/pdfs-%26-thumbnails/catalogs-and-literature/engine-bearings/ceb-2-1114-engine-bearing-failures-brochure.pdf — broken or plugged passages, blocked suction screen and pump malfunction can cause oil starvation; location of obstruction matters.

rows.text: 机油泵发生故障时，可能无法以所需压力向油路供油，从而使警告灯亮起。
evidence: Motorservice, oil level and pressure sensors: https://www.ms-motorservice.com/int/en/technipedia/oil-level-and-oil-pressure-sensors — low pressure can result from oil loss or defective pump.

rows.text: 油管破损可能导致漏油；吸油侧堵塞可能减少供油。两者都可能影响压力和润滑。
evidence: MAHLE, Engine Bearing Failures, p. 20, section 17: https://www.mahle-aftermarket.com/media/local-media-north-america/pdfs-%26-thumbnails/catalogs-and-literature/engine-bearings/ceb-2-1114-engine-bearing-failures-brochure.pdf — broken or plugged passages, blocked suction screen and pump malfunction can cause oil starvation; location of obstruction matters.

Motorservice, malfunction in engine lubricating system: https://www.ms-motorservice.com/tr/en/technipedia/malfunction-in-the-engine-lubricating-system-626/ — broken tube lets pressurized oil drain to sump.

rows.text: 油底壳中的机油过少时，机油泵可能吸不到足够的油来维持油路压力。
evidence: Volvo S60L 2016 owner’s manual, Information displays – warning symbols, Low oil pressure: https://www.volvocars.com/en-ca/support/car/s60l/article/5796f223aaefe254c0a801e800894856/ — identifies the low oil pressure warning and instructs the driver to stop the vehicle and engine if it lights while driving.
Motorservice, oil level and pressure sensors: https://www.ms-motorservice.com/int/en/technipedia/oil-level-and-oil-pressure-sensors — low pressure can result from oil loss or defective pump.

Jones & Bartlett Learning, Engine Repair, chapter 12, p. 306, Technician Tip: https://samples.jbpub.com/9781284056730/ch12_mlr_sample.pdf — at a very low oil level the pump draws air and oil pressure falls.

rows.text: 活塞环磨损后，对气缸壁上机油的控制变差，更多机油可能进入燃烧室并被消耗。
evidence: Motorservice, Piston Damage, https://www.ms-motorservice.com/int/en/technipedia/piston-damage-1518 — section on abrasive wear: worn piston ring surfaces and edges no longer seal against oil entering the combustion chamber; introductory section describes combustion oil consumption.

rows.text: 机油滤清器截留循环机油中的杂质，减少到达润滑表面的磨蚀性颗粒。
evidence: MANN-FILTER product brochure, oil filters: https://www.mann-filter.com/content/dam/website/mann-filter/mann-filter-com/en/documents/mann-filter-product-brochure-for-cars-and-transportersr.pdf — oil filter removes dirt and combustion residues from oil.

rows.text: 黏度表示机油流动时的阻力。它随温度变化，机油变热时通常会降低。
evidence: Castrol, Motor oil viscosity grades, What do the viscosity numbers mean?: https://www.castrol.com/en_ca/canada/home/products/our-brands/viscosity-grades.html — viscosity is resistance to flow; engine oils thin as they warm.

evidence: Ford, Engine Oil Check: https://www.fordservicecontent.com/Ford_Content/vdirsnet/OwnerManual/Home/Content?ProcUid=G1937829&Uid=G1937828&buildtype=web&countryCode=USA&div=f&languageCode=en&moidRef=G539653&userMarket=USA&vFilteringEnabled=False&variantid=6081 — level ground, engine off and waiting for drain-back; dipstick procedure and specified oil.
